files.bundle/D1.md:
# D1 / B1 Cache refresh

Status: planned, not implemented. Stale cache survives update notifications because invalidation is missing. Selected design: invalidate only changed keys on notification, preserving existing API. Direct coverage: stale reads after notification. Indirect: fewer redundant retries. Not covered: network loss. Acceptance: changed cache entry refresh <2 seconds after notification. Reject: stale reads persist, or any control command changes. Implementation slice: add invalidation, then targeted tests. Open decisions: none.
files.bundle/D2.md:
# D2 / B2 Retry diagnostics

Status: planned, not implemented. Add timestamps to retry logs. Direct coverage: observability of retry timing. Does not change retry policy or commands. Acceptance: each retry has correlated timestamps. Reject: altered retry behavior.
files.bundle/D3.md:
# D3 / B3 Network loss

Status: deferred. D1/D2 do not solve network loss. No implementation authorized. Acceptance for any future design requires a separately confirmed network-loss policy.

Intent: expose handler latency without changing outputs or control behavior. No public API change. Implement wrapper timing and targeted tests.
